title: 团队协作与配合

# 团队协作与配合

## 概述

本章围绕团队协作场景组织词汇，分为协作动词、团队角色与分工、沟通与反馈、协作工具与流程四个部分。重点是最常用的协作动作词——谁负责、谁配合、谁跟进，以及如何表达分工与反馈。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，覆盖日常对话与书面同步两种需求。学习时建议把动词与其常见搭配一起记忆，这样在描述协作过程时能直接成句。

## 协作动词

| 词汇        | 词性 | 含义 | 常用搭配                                        |
| ----------- | ---- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| collaborate | v.   | 协作 | collaborate with, collaborate on a project      |
| coordinate  | v.   | 协调 | coordinate efforts, coordinate across teams     |
| delegate    | v.   | 委派 | delegate tasks, delegate authority              |
| contribute  | v.   | 贡献 | contribute to, make a contribution              |
| facilitate  | v.   | 促进 | facilitate discussion, facilitate communication |
| align       | v.   | 对齐 | align on goals, align expectations              |

### 听说例句

> A: How do you collaborate with the design team? B: We have a weekly sync to align on priorities, and we use Figma for real-time feedback.

> A: Can you delegate some of these tasks? B: Sure, I'll coordinate with the junior developers and assign the smaller items to them.

### 写作表达

- The team collaborated closely with stakeholders to ensure alignment on product goals.
- Effective delegation enables managers to focus on strategic decisions while empowering team members.

---

## 团队角色与分工

| 词汇             | 词性  | 含义        | 常用搭配                                              |
| ---------------- | ----- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| lead             | n./v. | 负责人/领导 | team lead, lead a project                             |
| owner            | n.    | 负责人      | task owner, product owner                             |
| contributor      | n.    | 贡献者      | individual contributor, key contributor               |
| cross-functional | adj.  | 跨职能的    | cross-functional team, cross-functional collaboration |
| hands-on         | adj.  | 亲力亲为的  | hands-on experience, hands-on manager                 |
| accountable      | adj.  | 负责的      | hold accountable, be accountable for                  |

### 听说例句

> A: Who's the owner of this feature? B: I'm the tech lead, and the PM owns the product side. We work as a cross-functional pair.

> A: Are individual contributors expected to attend sprint planning? B: Yes, everyone is accountable for their own estimates and commitments.

### 写作表达

- Cross-functional teams bring together diverse perspectives and accelerate problem-solving.
- As the project owner, she is accountable for both the timeline and the quality of deliverables.

---

## 沟通与反馈

| 词汇      | 词性  | 含义     | 常用搭配                                  |
| --------- | ----- | -------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| sync      | n./v. | 同步     | daily sync, sync up with                  |
| follow up | v.    | 跟进     | follow up on, follow-up meeting           |
| escalate  | v.    | 升级     | escalate an issue, escalate to management |
| loop in   | v.    | 拉入讨论 | loop in stakeholders, loop someone in     |
| update    | n./v. | 更新     | status update, update the team            |
| feedback  | n.    | 反馈     | give feedback, constructive feedback      |

### 听说例句

> A: Should we escalate this blocker to the director? B: Let me follow up with the infra team first. If they can't resolve it by tomorrow, we'll escalate.

> A: Can you loop in the QA lead on this thread? B: Already done. I also gave them a status update on the testing timeline.

### 写作表达

- Please follow up with the client regarding the outstanding deliverables by end of week.
- Constructive feedback is most effective when it is timely, specific, and solution-oriented.

---

## 协作工具与流程

| 词汇        | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                               |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| workflow    | n.   | 工作流   | streamline workflow, standard workflow |
| pipeline    | n.   | 流水线   | CI/CD pipeline, data pipeline          |
| sprint      | n.   | 冲刺     | sprint planning, two-week sprint       |
| backlog     | n.   | 待办事项 | product backlog, backlog grooming      |
| milestone   | n.   | 里程碑   | project milestone, reach a milestone   |
| deliverable | n.   | 交付物   | key deliverable, final deliverable     |

### 听说例句

> A: When is the next sprint planning session? B: It's on Monday. We need to groom the backlog and finalize the deliverables for this cycle.

> A: Have we reached the first milestone yet? B: Almost. The pipeline is set up, and we just need to pass the integration tests.

### 写作表达

- Streamlining the workflow reduced the average feature delivery time from three weeks to ten days.
- The team achieved all major milestones ahead of schedule, demonstrating strong execution capability.
